newsitem.title: THAILAND: IFCT to get okay to run ailing Thai bank.
newsitem.headline: IFCT to get okay to run ailing Thai bank.

text.p: A plan to enable the Industrial Finance Corp of Thailand to run the troubled Bangkok Bank of Commerce Plc is expected to be approved by Thursday, Thai central bank governor Rerngchai Marakanond said.
Under the contract to be approved, IFCT will manage the bank for seven years, he said, adding that private companies will be hired to collect the debt.
"We will evaluate IFCT's performance annually. If they underperform, we can revoke the contract," he said.
Bangkok Bank of Commerce was taken over by the government last May after opposition politicians said it was saddled with about 77 billion baht ($2.96 billion) in non-performing and doubtful debts.

Former top executives of the bank, including former president Krikkiat Jalichandra, have since faced charges of embezzlement and conspiring to defraud the bank by approving big loans with inflated collateral to associated business.
